'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2023 Brussels shooting]]
**[[Belgian police|Police]] in [[Brussels]], [[Belgium]], shoot and kill the [[Islamic State]] sympathizer who killed two [[Swedes|Swedish]] [[tourism in Belgium|tourists]] yesterday. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-67131128 (BBC News)]
*[[Arab–Israeli conflict]]
**[[Gaza-Israel conflict]]
***[[Israel–Hamas war]]
****[[Al-Ahli Arab Hospital explosion]]
*****At least 471 people are killed and 314 others are injured by an [[explosion]] at [[Al-Ahli Arab Hospital]] in [[Gaza City]], according to the [[Hamas]]-run [[Palestinian Ministry of Health#Health Minister of the Gaza Strip|Gaza Ministry of Health]], saying it was caused by a [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] [[airstrike]]. The casualties are transported to Gaza City’s main hospital, [[Al-Shifa Hospital|al-Shifa]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/diplomats-renew-calls-gaza-aid-iran-warns-israel-2023-10-16/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-gaza-hamas-war-biden-rafah-e062825a375d9eb62e95509cab95b80c (AP)]
*****The [[Israel Defense Forces]] claims to have evidence that the explosion was caused by a [[Palestinian Islamic Jihad]] rocket failure. A spokesman for Islamic Jihad calls the Israeli statement "a lie and fabrication." [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/diplomats-renew-calls-gaza-aid-iran-warns-israel-2023-10-16/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-gaza-hamas-war-biden-rafah-e062825a375d9eb62e95509cab95b80c (AP)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-says-assessment-shows-failed-islamic-jihad-rocket-launch-caused-gaza-hospital-blast/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*****[[State of Palestine|Palestine]]’s [[Palestinian Ambassador to the United Nations|Permanent Observer Mission]] to the [[United Nations]] sends a statement to media organisations challenging the veracity of comments from Israel after the explosion. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/17/israel-hamas-war-live-anger-after-israeli-strike-kills-500-in-hospital (Al Jazeera)]
*****The [[Organization of Islamic Cooperation]] releases a statement denouncing Israel for the hospital explosion and the international community for its “impunity” in the war in Gaza. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/17/israel-hamas-war-live-anger-after-israeli-strike-kills-500-in-hospital (Al Jazeera)]
*****[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] postpones an upcoming [[List of international presidential trips made by Joe Biden|visit]] to [[Jordan]] following the explosion. [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/10/17/biden-netanyahu-jordan-israel-hamas-war-00122066 (Politico)]
****[[2023 Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]], [[Gaza Strip evacuations]]
*****The [[Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights|UN High Commissioner for Human Rights]] says that Israel's blockade of [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] and its [[emergency evacuation|evacuation]] order in northern Gaza may amount to a forcible transfer of [[civilian]]s, which is a violation of [[international law]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2023/10/17/israel-hamas-gaza-un-war/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israels-gaza-evacuation-order-could-amount-crime-forcible-transfer-civilians-un-2023-10-17/ (Reuters)]
****[[October 2023 UNRWA school airstrike]]
*****An Israeli airstrike hits a [[United Nations]] school inside a [[Palestinian refugee camp|refugee camp]] in Gaza, killing at least six of the more than 4,000 people sheltering there. Dozens more are injured, including [[UNRWA]] staff. [https://www.unrwa.org/newsroom/official-statements/gaza-unrwa-school-sheltering-displaced-families-hit (United Nations)]
*****The [[Ministry of Health (Israel)|Israeli Ministry of Health]] says that 4,399 people in Israel have been injured since the start of the war. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/health-ministry-says-almost-4400-wounded-in-israel-since-start-of-war/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*****The [[World Health Organization]] says that 2,800 people have died and 11,000 have been injured in Gaza since Israeli air strikes began, with about half of those being women and children. [https://www.reuters.com/world/who-says-it-needs-urgent-access-gaza-deliver-aid-medical-supplies-2023-10-17/ (Reuters)]
*****The [[World Health Organization]] says that there have been 51 attacks against healthcare facilities in Gaza, killing 15 health workers and injuring 27 others, and that "we have seen consistent attacks on healthcare in the occupied Palestinian territory." [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/attack-gaza-hospital-unprecedented-scale-who-says-2023-10-17/ (Reuters)] [https://news.un.org/en/story/2023/10/1142472 (United Nations)]
*****Hamas announces that Ayman Nofal, a member of the general military council and commander of the central command in the [[Izz ad-Din al-Qassam Brigades|Al-Qassam Brigades]], was killed in an Israeli airstrike. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2023/10/17/Hamas-says-Israeli-strike-killed-senior-commander-Ayman-Nofal (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
***[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
****Five [[Hezbollah]] fighters are killed by [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli soldiers]] when trying to cross a barrier at [[Blue Line (withdrawal line)|the border]] with [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-military-says-killed-four-people-who-tried-infiltrate-lebanon-plant-2023-10-17/ (Reuters)] 
****Lebanese state media reports that villages [[Dhayra]] and others were "continuous(ly)" bombarded by the IDF overnight, allegedly using [[White phosphorus munitions]].[https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231017-israel-thwarts-infiltration-bid-from-lebanon-killing-four-army (France24)] In the early morning it was reported that multiple people were suffering from symptoms of suffocation after the IDF allegedly fired white phosphorus shells on the village. [https://efe.com/en/latest-news/2023-10-17/at-least-four-killed-in-lebanon-near-israel-border-red-cross-says/ (Efe)]
****Three people injured from a Hezbollah missile strike on the [[Metula]], [[northern Israel]].[https://apnews.com/article/lebanon-israel-hezbollah-clashes-cadccde8c6ce5400ee36fd12d3bfea52 (APNews)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2023 Ukrainian counteroffensive]]
***[[Ukraine]] launches [[MGM-140 ATACMS|ATACMS]] [[tactical ballistic missile]]s at [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] bases in [[Berdiansk]] and [[Luhansk]], saying that they destroyed nine helicopters and a [[supply depot]] and killed several Russian military personnel. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-67135163 (BBC News)] [https://apnews.com/article/atacms-ukraine-longrange-missiles-5fd95f32449d14da22b82d57d6ccab22 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Hungary–Russia relations]]
**[[Prime Minister of Hungary|Hungarian Prime Minister]] [[Viktor Orbán]] and [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] hold [[diplomacy|talks]] at the [[Belt and Road Initiative]] forum in [[Beijing]], [[China]]. [https://apnews.com/article/putin-orban-russia-hungary-china-beijing-2265f08fcfa37e28f4b890d5ecce5d2e (AP)]
*[[Russia and weapons of mass destruction]]
**The [[State Duma]] votes unanimously to revoke [[Russia]]'s ratification of the [[Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty]]. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2023/10/17/russia-moves-to-revoke-nuclear-test-ban-treaty-a82793 (AFP via ''The Moscow Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[LGBT rights in India]]
**The [[Supreme Court of India]] refuses to legalize [[same-sex marriage]], saying that this is a decision that needs to be made by [[parliament of India|parliament]]. [https://apnews.com/article/india-lgbtq-marriage-discrimination-f8be8a20f5d895ffadd6eb98960677cb (AP)]
*[[Killing of Wadea al-Fayoume]]
**The Diocese of [[Joliet, Illinois]], confirms that Joseph Czuba, the man charged with killing a 6-year-old [[Palestinian Americans|Palestinian]] [[Islam in the United States|Muslim]]  Wadea al-Fayoume and injuring the boy's mother, is a member of a local [[Catholic Church]] [[parish]]. [https://www.americamagazine.org/politics-society/2023/10/17/wadea-palestinian-six-year-old-stabbed-chicago-catholic-muslim-246307?cx_testId=7&cx_testVariant=cx_1&cx_artPos=1&cx_experienceId=EXX1Z6PTUNON#cxrecs_s (America)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[October 2023 Speaker of the United States House of Representatives election]]
**The [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] majority fails to deliver enough votes for [[Jim Jordan]] to become [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|House Speaker]] on the first vote, with 20 members of the Republican party voting against him.
